d: Bihar ke navada jile ke roh thana kshetr antargat bhandjor aur goriyari ganv ke bich 27 kattha jamin ko lekar chal rahe panch sal purane vivad ne khuni sangharsh ka rup le liya hai. is hinsak ghatna men golibari aur lathi-dandon se kie gae hamle men goriyari ganv nivasi 36 varshiy yuvak kamlesh yadav ki maut ho gaee, jabki parivar ke panch any sadasy ganbhir rup se ghayal ho gae hain, jinka aspatal men ilaj jari hai.
